historical_result_policy: V4 remains the published objective-mismatched benchmark: its selfish cells price through the unshifted deterministic zone table and are reported as descriptive. V5 replaces the selfish cells with an objective-matched leader decision and must be reported separately. V4 altruistic cells are already objective-matched and remain the citable altruistic results.
change_reason: the v4 program minimizes expected PTO cost in both coordination modes, so its profit-based cells compare configurations pursuing different objectives

match the benchmark to the leader--follower structure of the workflow: the tariff posture is the leader decision and is chosen to maximize projected full-day aggregator revenue, while the scheduling follower continues to minimize expected PTO cost given the tariffs
leave the shared deterministic optimizer, scenario sets, probabilities, prices, disturbance truth, asset identity bindings, Agent results and solver settings unchanged

method.leader_decision: tariff posture, selected ex ante at the first public information update and held for the operating day, matching the single-table structure of the deterministic pricing policy

revenue_matched_posture_grid.structure: uniform shifts applied to the deterministic selfish zone reference, then normalized by the same bounds that constrain the Pricing Agent (buy in [1.01, 1.50], buy <= 1.10 on the first six remaining timesteps, sell in [0.40, 0.99], sell <= buy - 0.01)

method.selection_criterion: maximum projected_full_day_aggregator_revenue of the first accepted optimization decision; this projection is the expected value over the frozen scenario set plus the already-settled prefix and uses no realized information
method.tie_break: smallest buy shift, then smallest absolute sell shift
